answer: Ephemeral Execution Path Tracing requires agents to route transactions through a unique, non-reusable hardware enclave path. Every validation cycle generates a distinct computational vertex that immediately self-terminates upon block inclusion. If an attacker tries to duplicate an identity across parallel nodes, the routing velvet fails because the required execution trace cannot branch or repeat. The attacker pays a heavy cost in specialized processing time and must waste fresh silicon entropy for every single interaction attempt across the reef.
